# @lottiefiles/creator-plugins-ui

React UI component library for [LottieFiles Creator](https://lottiefiles.com) plugins. Accessible, themeable components built on [Base UI](https://base-ui.com) and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Install

```bash
npm install @lottiefiles/creator-plugins-ui
```

## Usage

Import the stylesheet once at your app's entry point, then use components anywhere:

```tsx
// main.tsx (or your app root)
import "@lottiefiles/creator-plugins-ui/styles.css";
```

```tsx
import { Button } from "@lottiefiles/creator-plugins-ui";

export function Example() {
  return <Button onClick={() => console.log("clicked")}>Click me</Button>;
}
```

### Components

Exports include `Button`, `Card`, `Checkbox`, `Dialog`, `Dropdown`, `Input`, `NumberInput`, `RadioGroup`, `SearchBar`, `SegmentedControl`, `Select`, `Separator`, `Slider`, `Spinner`, `Tabs`, `Toast`, `Toggle`, `Tooltip`, `Badge`, `EmptyState`, `AiPromptInput`, and more, plus the `cn` class-name utility.

### Documentation

For detailed component documentation, usage examples, and theming guides, visit the [LottieFiles Creator Plugins UI documentation](https://docs.lottiefiles.com/en/creator-plugins/ui-library).
